name: 豆瓣
text:
#!name=豆瓣
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.douban\.com\/v\d\/app_ads\//i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.douban\.com\/b.*\/common_ads\?.*/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/img\d\.doubanio\.com\/view\/dale-online\/dale_ad\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/frodo\.douban\.com\/api\/v2\/movie\/banner/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/erebor\.douban\.com\/count\/\?ad=/i then reject(404)

[Rule]
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, erebor.douban.com,REJECT
DOMAIN-SUFFIX, ad.doubanio.com,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% api.douban.com
